description: This file defines the FavoritesAdapter class used in an Android app to display a list of favorite video items, allowing users to remove items via a button.

classes.name: FavoritesAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying a list of favorite VodItems in a RecyclerView, with functionality to remove items.

classes.name: FavoritesAdapter.FavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for FavoritesAdapter, representing individual item views.

methods.name: FavoritesAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view for each list item and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: FavoritesAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolder for the item at the specified position.

methods.name: FavoritesAdapter.getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.

methods.name: FavoritesAdapter.FavVH.bind
methods.description: Binds a VodItem to the view components and sets up the remove button's click listener.
